title: Te Wairua Kore Ingoa i Tū ki te Iwi Tikakore
intro: Kei roto i ngā whārangi o te Quran, kei reira ngā tāngata i hunaia ō rātou ingoa kia whakaaroarohia ai e tātou ā rātou akoranga. I whānau mai tētahi o aua wairua i roto i tētahi iwi i whakakahore i ā rātou karere, heoi he whakapono huna tō tēnei tangata i wehewehe i a rātou. I te taenga mai o te whakangaromanga, i tū pakari tēnei tangata i roto i tana whakapono ngaro. Ka taea e koe te hura i te tuakiri o tēnei tāngata ngaro e whakatūpato ana i tōna iwi i mua i te hekenga mai o te ture whakamutunga?
clues: I noho ahau i waenganui i tētahi iwi i whakakahore tonu i ngā karere i tonoa mai e Allah ki a rātou.
I rite ahau ki tōku iwi, i mōhio ahau ki te pono i te taenga mai o tētahi karere me ngā tohu mārama mai i tōku Ariki.
I huna e ahau tōku whakapono i ōku kaitukino, i te mōhio ka whara ahau i a rātou mēnā ka kitea e rātou tōku whakapono.
I te tata mai o te whakahau whiu, ka whakapuakina e ahau taku pono, ā, ka whakatūpato i taku iwi kia whakaorangia rātou anō.
I whakamahara atu ahau ki a rātou he karere pono ahau, kāore he rerekētanga i ērā i tonoa i mua, ā, kaua rātou e karakia ki tetahi atu engari ki a Allah.
I whakapae tōku iwi i ahau mō te mahi makutu me te porangi, heoi i te mutunga ka tau te whiu i whakatūpatohia ai rātou ki a rātou.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Ko Huta te poropiti, te karere ki te iwi o Āta
He tangata whakapono nō te iwi o te Poropiti a Huta i mate whakamātāra
Ko te rangatira o te iwi o Ād i whakakahore i te pono
He hoa o te Poropiti a Salih i ruarua i ngā tohu atua
I tonoa he anahera hei whakangaro i te iwi o Āta
identity.answer: He tangata whakapono nō te iwi o te Poropiti a Huta i mate whakamātāraitia

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Ko te whakamātautau a te tauraki me te matekai i whakamatautau i tō rātou manawanui
Ko te whakamātautau o te whakapuaki i te whakapono i mua i te iwi tukino, kore whakapono
Te whakamātautau i te hanga kaipuke hei mawhiti i te waipuke nui
Te whakamātautau i te maka ki te ahi mō te whakapono ki a Allah
Te whakamātautau i te taonga me te whai rawa
trial.answer: Ko te whakamātautau o te whakapuaki i te whakapono i mua i te iwi tukino, kore whakapono

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: Ko te tāone o Makkah te wāhi i hangaia ai te whare tapu
Ngā mania koraha o te iwi i whakakahore i tā rātou karere
Ngā maunga o Miriana i tonoa ai te Poropiti a Shu'aib
Te tahataha o te awa o Ihipa i kitea ai te poropiti a Mohi
Ko te awaawa o te iwi o Āta, i pāngia e te hau nui
location.answer: Ngā mania koraha o te iwi i whakakahore i tā rātou karere

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakaorangia ahau i roto i te kaipuke, ā, i ora ahau tae noa ki te wā i pai ai a Allah
I whakapono taku iwi i muri i ahau, ā, i arahina rātou ki te ara tika
I patua ahau e tōku iwi, engari i tangohia tōku wairua e te aroha o te Atua
I ripeneta ahau i muri i te whakamātautau, ā, i whakaae a Allah ki taku ripeneta
I muri i tōku matenga i hurihia ahau hei whakapakoko i karakiatia e tōku iwi
outcome.answer: I patua ahau e tōku iwi, engari i tangohia tōku wairua e te aroha o te Atua

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verse: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority (11:96)
